# Processed Data

This directory contains preprocessed data generated by `src/data_loader.py`:

- Grayscale, resized (256x256) images saved as numpy arrays
- Patient-level split indices for GroupKFold cross-validation
- Handcrafted feature matrices

## Generated Files (do NOT commit)

- `images.npy` — preprocessed image array
- `labels.npy` — binary labels (0=healthy, 1=PD)
- `patient_ids.npy` — patient identifiers for grouping
- `splits.pkl` — GroupKFold split indices
- `features_handcrafted.npy` — handcrafted feature matrix

These are regenerated by running `src/data_loader.py` and `src/train.py`.
Do not commit to git — they can be large and are reproducible from raw data.
